input.summary:
Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript per the C4 specification.

Files added:
- src/event-bus.ts: In-memory EventBus with publish/subscribe.
- src/services/user-service.ts: User CRUD with in-memory Map.
- src/services/project-service.ts: Project CRUD, addMember/removeMember.
- src/services/task-service.ts: Task CRUD, assign, changeStatus with forward-only status enforcement; publishes task events.
- src/services/comment-service.ts: Comment create/get/delete; publishes comment.added event. Uses injected resolvers for taskTitle and authorName to avoid direct service imports.
- src/services/notification-service.ts: Subscribes to task.assigned, task.statusChanged, comment.added; creates notifications and supports getByUser and markAsRead. Maintains a task assignee cache.
- src/router.ts: HTTP router using Node http and url. Implements all API routes as specified.
- src/main.ts: Wires EventBus and services, injects lookup functions to CommentService, starts server on PORT (default 3000).
- src/demo.ts: Demo script that starts a server on 3001, exercises users/projects/tasks/comments/notifications, shows notifications, and marks one as read.
- tsconfig.json: TypeScript configuration.

Notes:
- Attempted to run `npx tsc --noEmit`, but TypeScript is not installed in this environment. Code is strictly typed and should compile when TypeScript is available.
- The system can be run with `npx tsx src/main.ts` (assuming tsx/typescript available) and demo with `npx tsx src/demo.ts`.
